result.summary: No critical breakage is visible. The main issues are edge-clipped carousel content and feed content being obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category and “Fastest near you” carousels leave partially visible items cut off at the right edge, including a nearly blank category pill and the truncated “Smash Bros Bu…” card title.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel item widths, spacing, and right padding so the next item is shown as a clearer scroll affordance without awkwardly clipping its label.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the restaurant feed, visibly cutting across the pizza card image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation height so cards can scroll fully above the fixed bar.
